title: 9. A importância de não nos polarizarmos

queries.text: The original spells "Karen Salmanshon" and "Ammy Shuterland"; corrected to Karen Salmansohn (as in Masculine Reflections on Woman and Love) and Amy Sutherland (author of "What Shamu Taught Me About Life, Love, and Marriage", on applying animal-training techniques to a husband). Confirm the second identification.
